title: Grading the Graders: Verification Autonomy Levels (L0-L5) for LLM Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2608.19009v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly paired with verifiers (step checkers, self-consistency filters, tool-based fact checkers, formal proof assistants) that claim to detect the model's errors. Yet the verification literature uses the word "level" to mean at least five different things: verification granularity, concept abstraction, risk tier, system-stack layer, and the epistemic source of the ground truth. We propose Verification Autonomy Levels (VAL), a meta-standard classifying verification schemes along a single axis: where does the verification spec come from, and what does the verdict guarantee? VAL ranges from L0 (LLM self-declaration, no deterministic anchor) through L2 (objective ground truth, correctness only) to L3/L4 (decidable systems with single-property or domain-level completeness), with L5 impossible in the unrestricted case. translated_title: 给评分者评分：大语言模型推理的验证自主级别（L0-L5）
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地与验证器（步骤检查器、自一致性过滤器、基于工具的事实检查器、形式化证明助手）配对使用，这些验证器声称能检测模型的错误。然而，验证文献中使用“级别”一词至少指代五种不同的事物：验证粒度、概念抽象、风险层级、系统堆栈层以及地面真相的认知来源。我们提出验证自主级别（VAL），这是一种元标准，沿单一轴分类验证方案：验证规范来自哪里，以及裁决保证什么？VAL范围从L0（LLM自我声明，无确定性锚点）经过L2（客观地面真相，仅正确性）到L3/L4（具有单属性或领域级完备性的可判定系统），其中L5在无限制情况下不可能实现。VAL的核心是完备性盲点：基于替换和采样的验证器...
tldr: 本文提出了验证自主级别（VAL）这一元标准，用于按验证规范来源和裁决保证统一分类LLM推理验证方案，并指出完备性盲点问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Verification Autonomy Levels (VAL), a meta-standard classifying LLM reasoning verification schemes by spec source and verdict guarantee, highlighting the completeness blind spot.
